scope: Selected CAAS recreational outdoor-flight requirements; permits and location restrictions must be checked separately.

registrationRequired.note: Register aircraft above 250 g; outdoor operations above 250 g require Broadcast Remote Identification.

pilotCertRequired.note: Above 1.5 kg through 7 kg: Basic Training Certificate or Pilot Licence. Above 7 kg: Pilot Licence.

altitudeNote: No altitude rule verified in this summary.

insuranceRequired.note: Not verified in this summary. Check the national authority for your aircraft and operation.

importRestriction.note: Import and radio-equipment requirements have not been verified.

notes: Desk research from official sources, not firsthand flight verification. Check current notices and site permissions before a flight.
